Text.Text: The shutdown cell is finished. Keep your future work as quiet and deliberate as this one. You've finished my Escape Artist trials. I have no further work for you here.
Reach rank 50 in Vibroknife, then come back for this assignment. Quiet work still requires practiced hands.

An unauthorized crew is running shutdown drills in the militia annex. Recover its ledger so I can trace the operation. Defeat six Systemic Shutdown Adepts in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Systemic Shutdown Veles Drill Ledger; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Czerka Tower. I'll give you the Veles Militia Annex Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Escape Artist.

Here's the Veles Militia Annex Key. Use 'Veles Militia Annex' in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Systemic Shutdown Adepts, then return with the Systemic Shutdown Veles Drill Ledger.

Systemic Shutdown is the name of the school you're confronting. The technique these trials qualify you to learn is Escape Artist. Recovering its records and defeating its master will show me you're ready for that training.

Use 'Veles Militia Annex' in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Systemic Shutdown Adepts in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Systemic Shutdown Veles Drill Ledger; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Czerka Tower.

Six adepts, none of them subtle. They'll telegraph everything - the loud ones always do. That won't make them harmless. Watch the ones who go quiet when you walk in; those learned something real by accident.
Defeat six Systemic Shutdown Adepts in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Systemic Shutdown Veles Drill Ledger; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Czerka Tower.
You've defeated six Systemic Shutdown Adepts. Let me see the Systemic Shutdown Veles Drill Ledger.
Record recovered. We can trace the orders now. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists control the annex's range relay. Recover it and cut off their training equipment. Defeat five Systemic Shutdown Specialists in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Systemic Shutdown Militia Range Relay; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Czerka Tower.
Your key still grants access to Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Defeat five Systemic Shutdown Specialists to secure the Systemic Shutdown Militia Range Relay, then return to me.

The militia doesn't want a scandal, and a scandal is exactly what an unauthorized disabling technique becomes the moment it's loud. Contained quietly, it's a training irregularity. Reported loudly, it's a hearing, a suspension, careers ending over paperwork. I prefer the quiet version. So does everyone above me, whether they admit it or not.

Use 'Veles Militia Annex' in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat five Systemic Shutdown Specialists in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Systemic Shutdown Militia Range Relay; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Czerka Tower.

Five specialists who've stopped telegraphing. They'll try to end the fight before you know it started, which is the whole discipline working as intended, just aimed at you. Don't let them finish a sentence with your name in it.
Defeat five Systemic Shutdown Specialists in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Systemic Shutdown Militia Range Relay; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Czerka Tower.
You've defeated five Systemic Shutdown Specialists. Let me see the Systemic Shutdown Militia Range Relay.
Equipment recovered. Their training operation is disrupted. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden protects the shutdown crew. Bring back his challenge badge. Defeat the Systemic Shutdown Warden in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Systemic Shutdown Scored Challenge Badge; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Czerka Tower. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Viscara, Veles Militia Annex, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Systemic Shutdown Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Systemic Shutdown Scored Challenge Badge.

He didn't invent Systemic Shutdown, but he's the one who handed it to students who had no clearance for it and no discipline to match. I don't know why yet. I intend to find out from what's left of him.
In Viscara, Veles Militia Annex, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Systemic Shutdown Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

He's put down better than you, alone, against people who came alone. I won't send you into that same mistake. Three sets of eyes are harder to silence than one, and harder to explain away if something goes wrong.

Defeat the Systemic Shutdown Warden in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Systemic Shutdown Scored Challenge Badge; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Czerka Tower. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Systemic Shutdown Warden. Let me see the Systemic Shutdown Scored Challenge Badge.
Warden defeated. That breaks their enforcement. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four senior operators are still authorizing the drills. Recover their challenge chit. Defeat four members of the Systemic Shutdown Inner Circle in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Systemic Shutdown Captain's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Czerka Tower.
Your key still grants access to Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Defeat four members of the Systemic Shutdown Inner Circle to secure the Systemic Shutdown Captain's Challenge Chit, then return to me.

The drill ledger told me who was being taught. The range relay told me how long it had been going on. The scored badge told me the warden knew it was unauthorized and ran it anyway. Bring me the chit, and I'll know exactly how deep this goes and who signed off on it.

Use 'Veles Militia Annex' in Viscara, Veles, Sheriff/Clinic. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat four members of the Systemic Shutdown Inner Circle in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Systemic Shutdown Captain's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Czerka Tower.
Four of them, and none of them used to working outnumbered. Bring the company you brought last time. I'd rather you finish this with witnesses than alone with a story I have to take on faith.

Defeat four members of the Systemic Shutdown Inner Circle in Viscara, Veles Militia Annex. Their defeat secures the Systemic Shutdown Captain's Challenge Chit; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Czerka Tower.
You've defeated four members of the Systemic Shutdown Inner Circle. Let me see the Systemic Shutdown Captain's Challenge Chit.
Their officers no longer control the authorizations. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

The master is the last operator keeping the cell running. Defeat him in the Militia Command Room and report back. Defeat the Systemic Shutdown Master in Viscara, Militia Command Room. Report back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Czerka Tower; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Viscara, Militia Command Room, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Systemic Shutdown Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Systemic Shutdown Master fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.
In Viscara, Militia Command Room, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Systemic Shutdown Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

He taught shutdown work before the warden ever learned to spell it. Nobody who went in alone came back to file a report. Bring people who know how to stay quiet about what they see, because they will see something.

Defeat the Systemic Shutdown Master in Viscara, Militia Command Room. Report back to me here in Viscara, Veles, Czerka Tower; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Systemic Shutdown Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The shutdown cell is finished. Keep your future work as quiet and deliberate as this one. You've earned the right to train Escape Artist. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the ledger.
I'll defeat six Systemic Shutdown Adepts.
How does this school relate to Escape Artist?
Where do I find the annex?
What should I expect from the adepts?
Not yet.
Here's the Systemic Shutdown Veles Drill Ledger.
Back to the relay.
I'll defeat five Systemic Shutdown Specialists.
Why keep this quiet at all?
Where are the specialists working?
What should I expect this time?
Give me time to think it through.
Here's the Systemic Shutdown Militia Range Relay.
Back to the badge.
I'll defeat the Systemic Shutdown Warden.
Who taught the students this in the first place?
Where's the warden's floor?
What should I know about him?
I need to find the right two first.
Here's the Systemic Shutdown Scored Challenge Badge.
Back to the chit.
I'll defeat four members of the Systemic Shutdown Inner Circle.
What do the recovered items tell you?
Where's the inner circle hiding?
What am I walking into?
Let me finish arranging things.
Here's the Systemic Shutdown Captain's Challenge Chit.
Back to it.
I'll face the Systemic Shutdown Master and report back.
Would you recommend bringing help?
Where do I find him?
What should I expect from the master?
I need to be sure of who's coming with me.
The Systemic Shutdown Master is defeated. Here's my report.
